description: Land Acquisition - Menikhinna, Kundasale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described parcels of land are required for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands), this is only in the context of issuing the land acquisition declaration, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is land-related, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
